$comment: Human Repair Graph — relationship vocabulary (v0.3). Deliberately small. Every relation says where it is STORED (one place only; the inverse is derived by the build, never hand-written, so the two can never disagree).

relations.name: REQUIRES
relations.shape: array of groups: {"all": [ids]} means every member is needed (AND); {"any": [ids]} means one member suffices (OR). Groups are ANDed together.
relations.semantics: The dependent cannot be achieved without the requirement. An OR group records that nobody yet knows which alternative will succeed — that uncertainty is data, not a modelling shortcut.
relations.note: ALTERNATIVE_TO is not a separate relation: two capabilities in the same {any} group are alternatives for that requirement.

relations.name: ENABLES
relations.semantics: X enables Y iff Y requires X. Computed at build time; a hand-written enables list would be a second copy of the same fact.

relations.name: BLOCKED_BY
relations.semantics: An open question whose answer gates progress on this capability. The capability's grade.blocked field says which KIND of thing blocks it (science vs framework); this relation says WHICH unresolved question.

relations.name: SUPPORTS
relations.semantics: The claim, if true, is evidence that the capability has been demonstrated at (at least) the claim's rung. A capability's grade must be traceable to at least one supporting claim or an explicit 'no evidence located'.

relations.name: CONTRADICTS
relations.semantics: Direct tension: the two cannot both be true as stated, or the claim is a null/negative result against the capability. Never resolved by deletion — both stay, and a question should exist that would discriminate.

relations.name: REPLICATES
relations.semantics: Same finding, different group. Only counts as independent when the groups share no senior author and no sponsor — the L5 rung rests on this word, and the map has already had to demote one record for misusing it (Brineura, 2026-07-27).

relations.name: TESTS
relations.semantics: Running this experiment would produce an observation that discriminates between the question's live hypotheses.

relations.name: RESOLVES
relations.semantics: A claim whose acceptance closed (or would close) the question. A question with a non-empty resolvedBy and state 'open' is a contradiction the build rejects.

relations.name: MEASURES
relations.semantics: What was actually observed, separate from what was concluded. The observation survives even if every interpretation of it is later overturned.

relations.name: CITES
relations.semantics: Every evidence item points at exactly one source record with a locator (figure, table, page, section). A claim with no evidence cannot enter the map.

relations.name: TARGETS
relations.semantics: The grid node (cell type or non-cellular structure) this capability acts on. Derived grid capabilities (one per cell × class) always carry it; hand-authored capabilities carry it when they are specific to a node.

relations.name: PROJECTS_TO
relations.semantics: Which public map(s) show this node: universal-repair, rejuvenation, or both. Projections are views over ONE graph; a node never exists twice.

projections.name: Universal Repair
projections.tagline: From trauma and infection to cancer and organ failure.

projections.name: Rejuvenation
projections.tagline: From biological aging to restored youthful function.

projections.name: Full Research Graph
projections.tagline: Capabilities, dependencies, evidence, blockers, and next experiments.
projections.note: Not a tag — the union. Every node is in the full graph.
